structured.feedback: Meets the core requirements: SEO-style title and subheadings, Markdown, about 230-250 words, no links, no invented quotes, and no mention of the peeling or the 7-day wait. Minor issues: "leaving skin feeling smooth after a single use" leans toward overpromising given the mixed reviews, "spa-style pedicure" is a bit hyperbolic, a few sentences use passive voice ("is enriched," "Cleanup is quick"), features and benefits are not explicitly distinguished, and the unique selling point of a non-chemical, non-peeling treatment is left out.
